verdict.rationale: The evidence covers PR review, CLI/MCP access, and feedback widget features, but there is no mention of exporting user data in open/portable formats or facilitating account/data migration away from Foreloop. The --json CLI output is for programmatic access to live data, not a documented bulk data-export/portability feature. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. No export or offboarding capability is documented; 'a user could script their own JSON extraction' is judge inference, and submissions/review findings are not covered even by that workaround. Same call as the claude-code openness-full-export revert in this wave — one bar for all owner products. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
